description: Basic single-turn research query with synthetic memory data
notes: This task exercises the vector path only, and the seed data is why. CypherNeo4jReader.expandFromSeeds returns :Fact nodes reached through (seed:Concept)-[:RELATES_TO*0..n]-(:Concept)<-[:MENTIONS]-(f:Fact), which is ADR 0004's one-candidate-universe change; expectedSeeds writes :Concept nodes and RELATES_TO edges and no :Fact, so the graph retriever returns zero candidates from it regardless of the query. Independently, retrieveNode derives seed ids from capitalized tokens in the last user message, and this question yields ["what"], which matches neither concept-a nor concept-b. A graph-path task needs a seed format that writes facts and their MENTIONS edges; P2-B's ablation is what needs one. trajectory_precision over the node sequence is reported rather than gated because act loops up to maxSteps and every extra iteration lowers it; the tool metrics are reported rather than gated because whether the model reaches for a tool is a property of the model, and the stub set never does.
